title: Blended per-vector + batch pricing experiment for embeddings & rerank
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a controlled experiment to evaluate a hybrid pricing model that combines per-vector unit economics with explicit batch discounts for embeddings and reranking calls. Aim: find a simple, defensible pricing ladder that preserves unit economics for small realtime requests while giving material savings to high-throughput batch customers and heavy rerank workloads. Deliverables: experiment config, customer-facing pricing examples, QSA-ready contract language, and rollout plan for hosted API and Dedicated quoting flows.
background: Customers increasingly mix bursty realtime vector lookups with large offline embedding jobs and periodic rerank scans. Our current per-vector unit price reflects median workload but penalizes high-volume batched jobs and underprices some rerank-heavy use cases (many short vectors per query). Sales and Solutions Engineering requested an experiment to validate batch discounts that (a) reduce TCO for large customers, (b) preserve revenues for small/interactive users, and (c) are simple enough to include in contracts and self-serve pricing pages. Previous PM tickets explored per-vector slabs and tiered bundles; this experiment tests a blended approach (base per-vector + tiered batch multipliers) with rerank-specific adjustments.
proposed_experiment: 1) Implement two additional pricing knobs in the billing simulator and experiment infra: a per-batch multiplier and a volume slab that applies when vectors in a single request exceed threshold. 2) Run split-test across self-serve API traffic and a curated set of partner accounts (opt-in). 3) Collect top-line revenue, compute cost (GPU/infra delta), and product metrics (latency, error-rate) for 8 weeks. 4) Produce recommended public price ladder and contract clauses for enterprise QSA/QC review.
pricing_matrix: Experiment A (modest batch discount): $0.00065 per vector + 10% discount when request vector count >= 256
Experiment B (aggressive batch tiers): $0.00060 per vector + tiered multipliers: 256-1024 => 15% off, >1024 => 30% off

Rerank adjustment: add 'per-query' multiplier for rerank workloads where each query issues N vectors; simulated as an effective 1.2x per-vector consumption for rerank customers unless they run batched rerank pipelines.
buckets: Control: current per-vector pricing (no batch discounts)
Variant 1: small discount (Experiment A) applied automatically in billing engine simulator; exposed to partners via pricing quote only
Variant 2: tiered discount (Experiment B) with explicit slabs; test both self-serve and sales-assisted quoting
Partner cohort: opt-in set of 10 existing high-volume customers with sales-managed communication and dedicated monitoring
success_metrics: Net revenue change vs control >= -5% while increasing gross margin for batch-heavy customers
Customer churn impact for small users < 1% absolute vs control
Average effective price per vector for top 10% volume customers falls by at least 18% (evidencing meaningful savings)
No increase in API latency or error rate attributable to pricing (should be 0 regressions linked to experiments)
Clear contract language and QSA artifacts created and signed off by Security & Legal
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Simulator and billing infra changes (ENG tickets assigned). Phase 1: internal dry-run with synthetic workloads and finance simulator (2 weeks). Phase 2: partner cohort (4 weeks) + close monitoring. Phase 3: limited public rollout to self-serve users via pricing page and feature flag (2 weeks). Phase 4: full roll if revenue and margin targets met, otherwise refine discounts and rerun.
notes: Sales asked for a simple 'X% off above Y vectors/request' rule that can be boxed into enterprise quotes. We created two candidate shapes to test simplicity vs granularity trade-offs.

Cost model: finance shared a GPU tokenization + transform cost per vector estimate; that baseline will be used to compute margin impact. Need infra to tag rerank requests for more accurate accounting.
Customer messaging: feature brief drafted by Solutions Eng (Drive link). Must include examples converting 'per-query' rerank usage to 'effective vectors' for clarity.
Legal requires explicit examples in contract appendix and QSA evidence showing metering integrity (logs + S3 export). Security requested an access control checklist before enabling partner cohort.
We should coordinate with Console team to add a 'predicted monthly cost' preview for customers who opt-in to batch discounts so they can see savings before changing workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment infra runs for minimum 6 weeks across both self-serve and partner cohorts
Detailed revenue / margin / churn analysis completed and reviewed by Finance
Security & Legal sign-off on contract language and QSA artifacts
Public pricing page wording drafted and validated with Marketing
Implementation tickets merged to main and rollout paths documented in Console runbook
